[[File:Fitzwilliam.png|thumb|250px|Fitzwilliam]] '''Fitzwilliam''' (Japanese: '''ヨシミツ''' ''Yoshimitsu'') is [[Drake]]'s first mate and a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG101|Vanity Affair]]''. Fitzwilliam first appeared when waving at Drake when the ship was coming near land. He watched {{Ash}}'s battle against Drake from the sidelines. When {{an|May}} stated that Drake was not so strong—for a person in the [[Elite Four]]—Fitzwilliam told them not to be so sure, and to wait and see what he meant. Fitzwilliam also explained what Drake's strategy was with his {{p|Shelgon}}, when the Pokémon knocked out {{AP|Pikachu}}. He also preempted Ash's mast-climbing strategy when he sent out {{AP|Grovyle}}, who had the type disadvantage, against Drake's {{p|Altaria}}. Fitzwilliam recognized Ash's out-of-the-box battle strategy as the reason for Drake deciding to challenge him. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{dragon color}}|bordercolor={{dragon color light}} |ja=坂口候一 ''[[Kōichi Sakaguchi]]'' |en=[[Anthony Salerno]] |fi=Tommi Haapaniemi |fr_eu=Alexandre Crépet |no=Trond Teigen}}
